recognize_zh: 流式細胞儀散佈圖（CD138 PC5.5 對 CD38 PC7），圈選的 CD38 強陽性、CD138 陽性族群佔活細胞 24.23%；大量 CD38/CD138 雙陽性漿細胞支持漿細胞腫瘤，但需再以 CD19、CD56、CD45 與輕鏈判斷是否為克隆性。
features: Bivariate dot plot gated on live cells: CD138 PC5.5 (x-axis) versus CD38 PC7 (y-axis)
Large gated population (green) with bright CD38 and CD138 expression ranging from dim to bright
CD38+CD138+ events account for 24.23% of live events
Separate CD38-dim/negative CD138-negative populations (blue, gray) representing other marrow cells
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on live events shows a distinct population with bright CD38 and heterogeneous dim-to-bright CD138 expression, comprising 24.23% of live cells. Remaining events are CD38-dim to negative and CD138-negative. A plasma cell fraction of this magnitude is markedly increased, although flow cytometry often underestimates plasma cells compared with morphology. Clonality and neoplastic phenotype (e.g. CD19 negativity, CD56 or CD117 expression, CD45 loss, cytoplasmic light-chain restriction) must be established on additional plots before concluding plasma cell myeloma.
